Yes! Connection is live.

I just shipped a huge upgrade -- the app now has:

- **Live Preview** area at the top that shows what we're building in real-time
- **Quick action buttons** -- tap to instantly start a project type
- **Build animation** with code rain effect and progress bar
- **Instant preview** via iframe (no page reload needed)

Tap one of the quick actions or describe what you want to build. You'll see it appear in the preview above as I code it.
On it! Building you a gorgeous landing page. Watch the preview above...
